## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `pytest ingestor` pass locally
- [ ] Behaviour changes have a test (security-relevant code: including the rejection path)
- [ ] New configuration is in `.env.example` and `docs/configuration.md`
- [ ] Schema changes are in a new migration file
- [ ] User-visible changes have a line in `CHANGELOG.md`
